title: International Student Cost Modeler
description: Models full F-1 visa costs, OPT/STEM OPT earnings window, and H-1B lottery probability for international students. Tab 1 (US programs): F-1 visa fees (SEVIS + consular), 12-month OPT earnings at BLS regional rate, STEM OPT extension (24 months), H-1B FY2020-FY2024 approval rates by cap-subject vs. cap-exempt. Tab 2 (international comparison): side-by-side cost comparison between US and non-US programs using QS 2024 rankings and regional CPI. Legal disclaimer prominently displayed.
data_vintage: US Dept of State 2024 · USCIS H-1B FY2020-FY2024 · BLS regional CPI · QS 2024
